lastNarrative: [Civ 2/10] The world is currently in a very primitive state, with agents exhibiting simple survival behaviors but lacking the higher-level intelligence and coordination required to develop into a true civilization.

dangers.description: Prolonged famine conditions have severely depleted resources in the grass zone
The river flooding has caused the surrounding areas to become temporarily hazardous and inaccessible.
Increased tectonic activity is causing minor tremors in the rocky zone, making movement and gathering more hazardous.

coast.reason: Mild storm surges have temporarily churned up additional coastal resources

sand.reason: Recent rainfall has brought moisture to the sand, allowing vegetation to thrive temporarily

grass.reason: The prolonged famine conditions have continued to deplete resources in the grass zone, making foraging even more challenging.

water.reason: Increased rainfall has raised the water table, making aquatic resources more abundant

swamp.reason: Prolonged rainfall has created stagnant pools and increased vegetation growth in the swamp zone

river.reason: As floodwaters recede, the river banks become more stable and accessible

cave.reason: Increased seismic activity has opened new cave passages, exposing additional mineral resources.

forest.reason: Prolonged drought has reduced the availability of forest resources

rocky.reason: Increased seismic activity has caused some minor volcanic eruptions, exposing additional mineral resources in the rocky zone.

path.reason: Recent rains have compacted the soil on the paths, making them slightly more traversable

precursors.message: Faint tremors ripple through the ground...
Food is becoming scarce across the land...
